stories.headline: Google opens Computational Discovery
stories.summary: Google began rolling out Computational Discovery, an AI science tool built with ERA and AlphaEvolve, and added MCP access.
stories.why_it_matters: It pushes AI deeper into day-to-day scientific coding and experimentation.

stories.headline: Anthropic opens residency applications
stories.summary: Anthropic opened applications for its paid Residency program for established technical leaders interested in AI safety research.
stories.why_it_matters: It expands the pipeline of experienced people entering AI safety.
